newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Yates says margin pressure continues.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Yates says margin pressure continues.

text.p: Seed and agricultural chemicals maker Arthur Yates & Co Ltd said pressure on margins in the retail sector continue at the start of the 1996/97 year to June.
"Whilst sales during July have reached management targets, pressure on margins in the retail sector has continued," chairman Stanley Howard said in a statement accompanying the 1995/96 results.

Yates earlier reported a 52.8 percent rise in net profit to A$6.08 million in the year to June 30, 1996. Sales rose 10.8 percent to A$148.29 million in the year, while the final dividend was maintained at four cents a share.
"As indicated in our 25 July annoucement, profitability flowing from sales into the retail sector has been below expectations largely due to depressed general retail trading conditions," Howard said.
Last month, Yates said the 1995/96 would be below management targets, principally as a result of a decline in the last quarter.
Arthur Yates shares closed steady at 96 cents on Wednesday.
